item.title: Said & Checked, Delaware, 2026-11-24: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Chris Coons)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Chris Coons, U.S. Senator from Delaware: “The guy who was having an affair with a Chinese spy while working relentlessly to help China get access to as many AI chips as possible? Really?” Unsettled. The spy claim rests on news reports citing unnamed U.S. officials; no on-record official finding was found, and AP reports that Singaporean authorities found insufficient evidence she committed a crime. AskAmerica's lobbying disclosures show Nvidia filing reports from 2024 to 2026 on semiconductor trade policy and export controls, and AP reports Huang lobbied to loosen limits on chip sales to China, but the filings do not state a position on wider sales.
